designationHistory.name: Morton County land utilization project
designationHistory.indexText: The Secretary of Agriculture designated the Morton County land utilization project (KA-21) in Morton and Stevens Counties, Kansas a national grassland, to be part of the National Forest System.

authority.citation: Order of the Secretary of Agriculture, June 20, 1960, 25 F.R. 5845 (36 CFR 213.1)

designationHistory.note: The 1960 order did not use the name 'Cimarron National Grassland'. It listed the area as the Morton County land utilization project (KA-21) in Morton and Stevens Counties, Kansas. The Chief of the Forest Service was authorized to name the grasslands (36 CFR 213.2); the date the current name was first applied was not found. Order signed June 20, 1960 by Acting Secretary of Agriculture True D. Morse; filed June 23 and published June 24, 1960. Some secondary sources give June 23, the filing date.
